text:
mira: Quick sync — marketplace + partner gateway handoff. Want to confirm press asset owners and SI integration checklist before we lock the page.

sam_pm: timeline check: press embargo is Tue 22nd 09:00 PT, right? we need assets by Mon EOD.

alex_sales: yes embargo confirmed. I'll get partner quotes by Fri. cc @jordan_eng for demo creds.

jordan_eng: Demo env for hardware partner (NVIDIA pod) ready. Need a sample dataset from partner to validate perf. Also will need a model uri for the hosted listing.

devon_ops: Ops checklist: infra templates, VPC peering docs, and KMS keys. I can drop templates here: https://internal.redwood.dev/marketplace/infra-templates

mira: putting a short handoff checklist — fill owners and statuses, please:
```
- Press assets (blog + 2 partner quotes) — owner: sam_pm — status: in progress
- Landing page copy & hero screenshot — owner: mira — status: draft
- Partner demo creds & perf report — owner: jordan_eng — status: needs dataset
- SI integration docs (1-pager + contact) — owner: alex_sales — status: collecting contacts
- Security review (KMS + audit logs) — owner: devon_ops — status: pending
- Launch playbook & runbook — owner: launchbot — status: draft
```

sam_pm: I'll update press asset status later today. question: do we need partner-specific CTA on LP or shared flow? @alex_sales

alex_sales: partner-specific CTA preferred for co-marketing; easier for tracking. will propose variations by Fri.

jordan_eng: can someone @partner-eng make a small sample s3 bucket public? we need ~10GB of logs to run the perf test.

devon_ops: tagging infra team channel. I can set up a temporary signed url if partner can't make public.

mira: ok owners: sam_pm -> press, alex_sales -> partner CTA + SI contacts, jordan_eng -> demo + perf, devon_ops -> infra + security. Launchbot — can you generate the runbook skeleton? @launchbot

launchbot: runbook skeleton created: https://playbooks.redwood/marketplace/co-launch/1745678999

sam_pm: note for press: include embargo language, partner quote approvals, and JIC placeholder if partner delays.

alex_sales: timeline recap: assets by Mon EOD, perf validation by Tue noon, final LP copy Tue 4pm, freeze Wed morning for QA.

mira: perfect. last ask — anyone running a conflicting campaign that week? @marketing @growth

sam_pm: pinged marketing lead offline; will report back by EOD.

mira: great, thanks all :raised_hands:
